title: Stamina+ Stack
descriptionHtml:
The two supplements that work together for performance, drive, and recovery — bundled and discounted.

Each Stamina+ Stack contains one Libido (Male formula) and one Testosterone Support. The Libido formula features Tongkat Ali, Muira Puama, L-Arginine, and Maca for stamina and drive. Testosterone Support features Zinc, D-Aspartic Acid, Ashwagandha, Fenugreek, and Vitamin D3 to support healthy testosterone levels, energy, and recovery.

Designed to be taken daily, together. Save 15% vs buying separately. Lab tested, third-party verified, 60-day money-back guarantee.
